constraints: keep sampled and volume evidence separate

p2.candidate: share six real reference curl/mass tensors; compose each exact cell metric; retain complex128 physical tensors and existing condensation/recovery
p2.qualification: FFCx matrix/action, Schur and nonzero-RHS recovery; exact identity; bounded true G0/G1 cell-type inventory; count init/composition/orientation/scratch and unique backing bytes
p2.adoption_rule: adopt only reproducible end-to-end benefit with acceptable resident/transient memory; otherwise record negative and use original exact path

conditional_formal_stages.F2_F3: G0 manual M1=180 then M2=340; actual ordered channel inventory is authoritative
conditional_formal_stages.F4: G0 manual M3=532 only if M1/M2 remain unstable and safe
conditional_formal_stages.F6_F7: E1 q=1.25, then E2 q=1.5 only if safe; fixed 0.7 nm and new-period mode envelope
